correctness.rationale: Reconstructed plane-tree decomposition T=z/(1-T), level-marking A_h=T(T/(1-T))^h and root-degree mixed mark B_h=A_h+2A_{h+1}. Lagrange inversion yields a_{n,h}=(2h+1)/(n+h)*binom(2n-2,n-h-1). The ratio a_{n,h+1}/a_{n,h} reduces to the sign polynomial n+1-h-2h^2 with all other factors positive. Top-level a_{n,n}=0, n=2 zero/negative boundary and h=0 deterministic treated separately. Telescoping central-binomial quotient for h~t sqrt(n) gives e^{-t²} and the claimed limit. Independently enumerated all 625 plane trees of n=2..8 and checked each depth against the rational formula; this finite check does not prove the all-n theorem.
